BIOLOGY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Support in Plants.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support in Plants.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support in Plants.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support in Plants.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor? (1 mark)

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.

   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement in Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement in Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement in Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement in Animals.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Genetics.

   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Animals.

   C. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Animals.

16. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of? (1 mark)

   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

20. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring
